statement:
∀ (k : ℕ) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (2^(k+1))), 1 ≤ k →
  (χ.IsPrimitive ↔ χ ((1 + 2^k : ℕ) : ZMod (2^(k+1))) = -1)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 二进反射与 Levent GRH · DR-0003 · 用约化核筛出二幂模数的全部本原特征
plain_statement.en: New route · Dyadic reflection and Levent GRH · DR-0003 · Select all primitive characters at a power of two using the reduction kernel

brief.zh: 模 2^(k+1) 约化到模 2^k 的单位核恰为 1 与 1+2^k。本原条件等价于后一个元素取值 −1。最低的比较是模 4 与模 2。
brief.en: The kernel of unit reduction from 2^(k+1) to 2^k consists of 1 and 1+2^k. Primitivity means the latter evaluates to −1. The first comparison is modulus 4 with modulus 2.
